method.rdap: Only anonymous HTTPS GET to Verisign /com|net/v1/domain/{registry-domain}; public pinned service IP, verified TLS, no redirect or credentials, bounded response and hard 11-second process deadline.
method.doh: Only anonymous A/AAAA RFC8484 requests to dns.alidns.com and doh.pub; public pinned resolver IP, verified TLS, no redirects, bounded response and hard 11-second process deadline.
method.pace: Two rounds, at most two concurrent worker processes, at least 0.4 seconds between worker process starts; no retries.
method.controls: In each round google.com/google.net and randomized synthetic negative .com/.net are checked for RDAP and each DoH provider. Candidate queries run only if corresponding TLD/service controls pass.

method_precision: Concurrency and interval refer to worker process starts; actual network requests may start closer together due to independent setup and DNS resolution.
No retry was scheduled. Failed per-TLD/service controls suppress only corresponding candidate queries; skipped queries are distinct from DNS observations.
Hard process deadline includes service DNS, connection, TLS, request and bounded response read.
limitations: Raw RDAP/DNS responses, registration or registrant details, concrete addresses, CNAMEs and user data are not retained; response digests do not reconstruct omitted responses.
No source host is contacted; no webpage, subresource or source rule is loaded or executed.
All observations share the same network path and occur close together; recursive resolver caching and network restrictions limit independence.
NXDOMAIN and registry 404 are time-specific observations, not proof of ownership, malware, source failure or permanent non-registration.
Syntactic registered-domain grouping does not prove common operation; existing sibling 301 does not prove that the source host works.
Static-policy data reflects the selected bundled-source snapshot, not user installations, dynamic blacklists or settings.
The collection scripts and draft are temporary build artifacts; raw responses are not retained.
The local collection scripts and draft were not included in the repository; a later request is a new observation, not a reconstruction.
Raw answers were intentionally not retained, so response hashes and historical classifications cannot be independently reconstructed from this evidence.
A source-related sibling returned HTTP 301 to another host without following the redirect; this does not establish site ownership, availability, safety or the destination content.
